what: The plan rewrites Gate B behavior but omits the file-level contract that still says reviewer suggestions are never auto-applied and the user is always prompted.
scenario_or_breakage: If implementers follow only the listed approval-gates sections, the same normative file will contain contradictory instructions and Gate B may be implemented or later reviewed against the stale no-auto-apply contract.
suggested_fix: Add an explicit edit to the top Contract paragraph in approval-gates.md so it describes default auto-apply plus --manual prompt mode.

what: The plan only updates Step 3.5 prose, but other loaded design prompts still say plan-review findings are applied only by explicit user choice.
scenario_or_breakage: Full and quick plan-review flows will emit/consume finding artifacts under stale semantics, contradicting the new default auto-apply branch and confusing future edits or prompt execution.
suggested_fix: Add these files to the plan and replace explicit-user-choice wording with Gate B mode wording, e.g. Step 3 only collects findings and Gate B applies them according to manual_gate_b.

what: The plan says to review structural pins only conditionally, but the existing harness has hard-coded /design flag allowlist and run-params persistence literals that will fail once --manual is inserted.
scenario_or_breakage: make lint will fail even if the implementation itself is correct, because test-design-structure still expects the old --partition/--brainstorm/--no-dedup sequence and two-boolean recovery merge.
suggested_fix: Add scripts/test-design-structure.sh to Files to modify and update the literal pins for [--manual|-m], manual_gate_b, the write-run-params invocation, and the three-boolean recovery guard/merge.

what: The plan conditionally updates README flag enumeration but omits docs/skills.md, which also exposes the /design argument string and public flag summary.
scenario_or_breakage: Consumer docs will disagree: README may show --manual while docs/skills.md still omits it, or both remain incomplete if implementation treats README as the only docs surface.
suggested_fix: Add docs/skills.md to the docs update scope alongside README and document --manual / -m in the same style as --brainstorm.
